defs.def: the rate at which sth happens or is repeated 发生率；出现率；重复率

ex.s: Shock absorbers originally applied to the space shuttle launch have also been set up in the cities with a high frequency 3o of earthquakes in order to protect buildings and save lives.
ex.t: 最初应用于航天飞机发射的减震器现在也被安装在频繁发生地震的城市中，以保护建筑物和拯救生命。

defs.def: the fact of sth happening often 频繁
the rate at which a sound or electromagnetic wave vibrates (= moves up and down) （声波或电磁波振动的）频率

ex.s: REFLECTING distribution violence frequency herb hatch capacity 1 The iconic Beijing National Stadium, also known as the “Bird’s Nest”, has a of 80,000.
ex.t: 反思：分布、暴力、频率、药草、孵化、容量。标志性的北京国家体育场，也被称为"鸟巢"，有8万个座位的容量。

ex.s: Adverbs later quickly constantly happily truly rarely purely Categories of Adverbs Adverbs Adverbs of Time later Adverbs of Manner Adverbs of Degree Adverbs of Frequency We don't like snow so we.
ex.t: 副词：后来、快速地、不断地、快乐地、真正地、罕见地、纯粹地。副词类别：时间副词、方式副词、程度副词、频率副词……我们不喜欢下雪，所以……

ex.s: Analyse Chinese people's reading habits, providing data on their reading frequency and duration, preferred media, etc.
ex.t: 分析中国人的阅读习惯，提供关于他们阅读频率和时长、偏好媒体等的数据。

defs.def: the number of radio waves for every second of a radio signal 频率（无线电信号每秒电波数）
